name: Touch Football
desc:
Fun but simple football (or soccer) game to enjoy with friends.

Learn the skill to shoot or pass by adjusting the speed and angle of impact with the ball.

The goal was to create a game that plays like football (or soccer) instead of selecting when to dribble, pass, or shoot.

I hope you like(👍) this game but remember that you (and the other players) will get the best experience with a fast Internet connection.

Please join the group Touch Games if you have any suggestions!

Season Update:
1. More accurate motion and curve
2. Elite Clan League
3. New game mode

Tags: Football, Soccer, Team Sports, TPS, MPS, Futbol
